messages:
maria: Quick async — onboarded zeta-llama3-smallq to staging and ran a focused eval against promptset_spanish.v2. Seeing a consistent date parsing regression (examples below). Suspect tokenizer splitting + KV-cache warmup.

maria: Ran: ```bash
python evals/run_eval.py --model zeta-llama3-smallq --prompts promptset_spanish.v2.json --save results/zeta-spanish.json
```

maria: Failing examples (from sample):
- Input: "Mi cumpleaños es el 1 de marzo."
  Expected extract: "1 de marzo"
  Model output: "1 de marz o"
- Input: "La reunión es el 12 de abril."
  Expected: "12 de abril"
  Model output: "12 de abril" (ok) — failures are intermittent around tokens with short suffixes.

sam: Interesting — can you paste the full tokenization for the first example? I can try repro locally after lunch.

maria: Tokenization (smallq): ["Mi", " cumpleaños", " es", " el", " 1", " de", " marz", "o"] — notice "marz" + "o" split. Baseline llama3-small tokenizes it as ["marzo"]

qa-bot: EVAL ALERT: date_parsing_accuracy dropped from 0.94 -> 0.76 on promptset_spanish.v2 (n=1,200). Error rate concentrated on tokens with trailing vowels after consonant clusters.

jordan: @maria could this be a quantization token merge issue? smallq vs baseline differences tend to show up like this. Also any changes in tokenization kernel recently?

maria: I checked model config; tokenizer merges are the same file, so runtime/kernel changes are the likely suspect. Also observed ~12% latency increase and higher first-token gap (KV warmup).

olivia: @eng-runtime fyi — pinging for kernel/tokenizer release notes. Any recent changes to subword splitting or tokenizers?

sam: I'll prep a small hotfix for post-processing whitespace/joins for date extraction and open a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4872 — pinging reviewers. Quick diff in the PR: 
```python
# normalize whitespace in date postproc
s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s).strip()
# merge stray single-char tokens for known date suffixes
s = re.sub(r'([a-zA-Z]) \b', r'\1', s)
```

olivia: :thumbsup: I can review later today and add the reg tests to the gating dashboard.

maria: Blockers: need approval to run an A/B run on dedicated infra (cost alert). Today: pair with @sam to land the small patch, run 2hr A/B on dedicated nodes, and push full eval report to results/ with diffs.

jordan: We have 2 spare nodes in cluster-dedicated tomorrow morning if that helps — DM me and I'll reserve.

sam: If the postproc doesn't mask the root cause we'll revert the runtime change. Will also add a test targeting token splits like "marz o".

maria: Thanks — leaving the two worst failing examples here. I'll post post-fix evals once landed. cc @olivia for QA follow-up.

olivia: I'll queue the regression suite and check encoding edge-cases (mixed NFC/NFD?). Also will add a note to the promptset metadata: "spanish-v2: watch token-splits for month names".

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: pr/4872 -> staging at 2024-11-09T15:30Z (auto-rollback on error).
